title: 2552. Count Increasing Quadruplets

examples.explanation: - When i = 0, j = 1, k = 2, and l = 3, nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j] < nums[l]. - When i = 0, j = 1, k = 2, and l = 4, nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j] < nums[l]. There are no other quadruplets, so we return 2.
There exists only one quadruplet with i = 0, j = 1, k = 2, l = 3, but since nums[j] < nums[k], we return 0.
